description: Ex Israeli AF 119 Sqn Shahak c/n CJ-34 (built December 1962), the last surviving Israeli photo-reconnaissance CJ, FAA from March 1983, last flight February 1991; fitted with a Dagger nose cone and formerly marked C-401 as BAM Tandil gate guard, placed on a pedestal in this plaza 29 April 2010 and now carries no serial. Photographed November 2012 and June 2017.
aliases: Mirage IIICJ; Mirage 3CJ; C-401; c/n CJ-34; C401
museum_name: Plaza VI Brigada Aérea Mirage Monument, Tandil
